q: 近3天每天的销售额
sql:
SELECT 
    date_trunc('day', o.shipped_at)::date AS "日期",
    round(sum(l.qty * l.price) / 1.13, 2) AS "销售额（不含税）"
FROM 
    order_line l
    JOIN biz_order o ON o.id = l.order_id
    JOIN store s ON s.id = o.store_id
WHERE 
    NOT o.is_test 
    AND NOT s.is_test
    AND o.status = 'shipped'
    AND o.shipped_at >= '2026-10-23' 
    AND o.shipped_at < '2026-10-25 15:42:00'
GROUP BY 
    date_trunc('day', o.shipped_at)::date
ORDER BY 
    "日期"

q: 今天每小时的订单数
sql:
SELECT 
    date_trunc('hour', created_at_biz) AS "时间",
    count(*) AS "订单数"
FROM biz_order o
JOIN store s ON s.id = o.store_id
WHERE NOT o.is_test 
  AND NOT s.is_test
  AND created_at_biz >= '2026-10-25' 
  AND created_at_biz < '2026-10-25 15:42:00'
GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', created_at_biz)
ORDER BY "时间"

q: 本周每天各渠道的订单数
sql:
SELECT 
    date_trunc('day', o.created_at_biz)::date AS "日期",
    o.channel AS "渠道",
    count(*) AS "订单数"
FROM biz_order o
JOIN store s ON s.id = o.store_id
WHERE NOT o.is_test 
    AND NOT s.is_test
    AND o.created_at_biz >= '2026-10-19'
    AND o.created_at_biz < '2026-10-25 15:42:00'
GROUP BY "日期", o.channel
ORDER BY "日期", o.channel
